name: State power & grid context

sources.generation: EIA annual net generation by state (data-sources/annual_energy_supply.json; producer_type "Total Electric Power Industry", energy_source "Total")
sources.demand: State retail electricity sales, latest 12 months vs 5 years earlier (data-sources/state_electricity_demand.json)

caveats: Annual generation balance does not represent spare grid capacity or guaranteed power availability.
Transmission proximity does not establish available interconnection capacity.
NERC regional adequacy does not guarantee utility service to any specific project.
States split across NERC assessment areas are reported as "NERC regional context unavailable" rather than guessed.

unmappedStates.WY: Split between WECC-Basin and WECC-Rocky Mountain
unmappedStates.MT: Split between WECC-Northwest and MRO areas
